mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific regime conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) signals weakening economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate below 2% indicates stable inflation expectations that support equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (PAYEMS growth > 200k).

mechanism_narrative: A dovish monetary policy stance (FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%) compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply capacity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is rising (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
